summary: Tested new position_offset_ft (Roof Plane 'Offset from left (ft)') and site_plan (Combined site plan) features on Office SPA + backend. Backend: 5/5 pytest passed — GET exposes position_offset_ft on every facet and site_plan on revision, PUT round-trips both, and a null-site_plan PUT preserves previously saved layout (Office-owned semantics). Frontend: facet-offset input persists across reload (9.75 saved on M1 of lead e7b41ad7 Rev 6), Combined site plan card renders 2 in-scope structures on d0df5baa (3rd 'Attached Garage' is in 'Preview needs review' state), drag persists offsets via PUT (server confirmed site_plan.offsets after save on rev 422ea69c). One BUG found: 'Reset layout' does not clear site_plan on the server.

minor.issue: The 'preserve on null' semantics collide with Office 'Reset layout' — the reset button sends site_plan=null which is then treated as 'preserve' by services/measurements.py:464 (`if payload.site_plan is not None`), so the previously-saved offsets remain in DB. Effect: users cannot fully clear a combined-layout once saved. Reset-then-Save toast says 'Measurement saved' but server retains old offsets.

ui_bugs.issue: Reset layout button (data-testid=combined-site-plan-reset) calls onChangeOffsets(null); Save sends site_plan=null which backend interprets as 'preserve'. Recommended fix: send { offsets: {} } instead of null in resetLayout (CombinedSitePlan.jsx line 82), OR change backend to distinguish explicit null (clear) vs missing (preserve). Verified via network capture: PUT body has site_plan: null; server GET still returns previous offsets afterward.

action_items: Fix Reset-layout clearing: change frontend/src/components/roof-sketch/CombinedSitePlan.jsx `resetLayout` to send `{ offsets: {} }` instead of `null` so the backend's 'None means preserve' branch is bypassed. Alternatively, change backend services/measurements.py:464 to accept explicit null as clear (harder — would require Pydantic to distinguish unset vs null).
critical_code_review_comments: backend/services/measurements.py:464 — the `if payload.site_plan is not None` gate silently keeps stale offsets whenever a client sends null. Since Pydantic cannot distinguish 'omitted' from 'null', this design forces every Office-side clear operation to send a non-null sentinel. Consider explicit protocol: `{offsets: {}}` = clear, missing key = preserve, and drop the null branch.

CombinedSitePlan.jsx: only two structures render on d0df5baa even though the revision has 3 in-scope structures — because 'Attached Garage' failed roof-generation and shows 'Preview needs review' upstream. Label text 'X structures combined... N needs review' correctly reflects this. No action, just noting the placed vs unplaced split works.
combined-site-plan-empty placeholder path was not exercised — no revision in the test data has >=2 saved structures with zero facets across all of them. Consider a small QA seed to cover this gate.
seed_data_creation: None — used existing seed revisions (b5a05924 L-Roof w/ 4 facets, 422ea69c 3-structure, 7d466513 draft). Backend tests mutated site_plan and position_offset_ft on b5a05924 and left them at test values; frontend tests wrote position_offset_ft=9.75 on M1 of 7d466513 and site_plan offsets on 422ea69c.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend: pytest /app/backend/tests/test_site_plan_and_offset.py -o addopts='' passes all 5 (get exposes fields, roundtrip, null-preserve, multi-structure, explicit overwrite). Frontend flow: (1) facet-offset-{i} input on Roof plane rows works and persists (verified on Rev 6 of lead e7b41ad7). (2) Combined site plan card only appears when >=2 saved structures (structure.id truthy). (3) Drag via real mouse works — Playwright must use `page.mouse.down/move/up` with steps, not JS-dispatched PointerEvent; the React handler needs the currentTarget to receive the actual bubble. (4) In-browser fetch('/api/measurements/...') does NOT auto-attach the JWT Bearer token; use axios or the backend directly (with requests + Bearer header) to verify server state. Known bug to retest after fix: Reset layout must actually clear site_plan on server.
rca of the issue: Root cause: `services/measurements.py:464` treats `payload.site_plan is None` uniformly as 'preserve' to protect Field-side saves that omit the key. But Pydantic v2 sends both 'unset' and 'explicit null' as `None` on the model, so the Office Reset action (which explicitly sets site_plan=null) cannot ever clear the DB column. Repro: on lead d0df5baa, drag House in Combined site plan, Save (site_plan persists correctly), then click Reset layout, Save — network PUT body shows site_plan=null, server responds 200 'Measurement saved', but GET still returns the previous offsets. Mitigation: switch resetLayout to pass `{offsets: {}}` in CombinedSitePlan.jsx line 82.
